numerics.rtol.note: Engineering solver-coordinate resolution; physical conservation and convergence acceptance thresholds unchanged. Replaces over-resolved settings that stalled a high-permeability UQ drying case.

numerics.atol.note: Engineering solver-coordinate resolution; physical conservation and convergence acceptance thresholds unchanged. Replaces over-resolved settings that stalled a high-permeability UQ drying case.

record.note: P87 separate proposed factor2 sintering-only comparison, same actual P71 start and original process. No numerical execution adopted.

new_independent_sintering_condition.scope: Original sintering only. Physical case, absolute times, all references, rtol/atol and original cooling/hold conditions unchanged.

source_only_forecast.qualification: Complete original resolved MRO call-site/branch graph is in docs/FULL_CYCLE_P87_SINTERING_TIME_INTERFACE.json#source_only_forecast.method_branch_graph. All nested primitive counts are source forecasts/unmeasured. Current actual science calls0.

sample_surface_Newton_forecast.scope: Original heat_transfer_from_conductivity surface solve, additional to mechanical8; internal solver calls unknown.

full_public_sample_source_multiplicity.qualification: Source AST selected-case branch/call-site multiplicities only; not executed production or dynamic instrumentation. Counts include every inherited method entry, not just unpack; external vectorized NumPy primitives remain in full branch graph, unmeasured.

additional_per_sample_routes.state_thermo: Thermoelastic.thermo ->FiniteGas.thermo ->FullCycle.thermo; source gas/mineral calorics, quartz polynomial5+phase, liquid equilibrium contrast; kinetic state replaces equilibrium once. Transport separately calls the same thermo at scalar furnaceT.
additional_per_sample_routes.skeleton_chemical_potential: Active porous elastic_response/elastic_strain/thermal_strain/phase_eigenstrain/phase_reference_volume, then carrier birth eigenstrain/reference again. No stored potential evaluation.
additional_per_sample_routes.gas_flux: transport ->gas_carried_enthalpy/source integrals; gas_diffusivity; pore_limited_pair_diffusivity ->gas_pair_free_diffusivity; gas_knudsen_diffusivity; wall_friction_molecular_flux ->gas_logmean_pressure+gas_wall_friction_matrix (6 pairs/12faces), original batched linear solve; gas_viscosity ->pure_gas_viscosity+Wilke mixing; thermo furnace reservoir. Darcy and entropy original arithmetic.
additional_per_sample_routes.water_flux: water_retention->water_fractions->retention_sites, water_carried_enthalpy, water_binding->water_fractions->retention_sites, water_mobility_resistance. Top rates has independent retention/binding calls; caloric capacity adds original binding-capacity arithmetic, no extra water_binding method call.
additional_per_sample_routes.heat: phase_conductivity->liquid_state->liquid_order and dry_temperature_conductivity_factor; pore_radiative_conductivity; heat_transfer_from_conductivity fixed numerics.surface_iterations Newton. No extra heat source.
additional_per_sample_routes.mechanics: porous_mechanical_rates ->elastic_response; thermal_strain; sintering_response->liquid_state->liquid_order; liquid_relaxation->liquid_order/liquid_coordinate_rate/liquid_driving_log_odds/liquid_equilibrium_log_odds/liquid_contrast; production calls driving separately; eigenstrain/reference birth; state_caloric_capacity->FiniteGas.caloric_capacity (gasCp/waterbinding), quartz polynomial5+phase, mineralcalorics, kinetic liquid_order. capture=False, no mechanical storage capture.
additional_per_sample_routes.center: FullCycle.center_temperature, original cellwise_partition=False ->(9*T0-T1)/8, K, no decode or thermo.

source_only_forecast.solver_internal_work: Unknown until future original solves; existing native RHS/Jac counters and separate nfev/njev/nlu recorded. _rhs_event adds its original kinetic phase unpack/elastic/affinity beyond rates. No rates/sample count substitution.

constructor_each.reference_mutation: Constructs initial_partition/b0/md/initial/vs0/vp0/es0/initialgas/scales/layout and all thermoelastic references. Loader restores savednumeric37 then partition/phase0/liquidreference. Constructor derived constitutive arrays use the identical saved physical config.
